api: BlueTally REST API v1 (https://app.bluetallyapp.com/api/v1); provider artifact version: v1; OpenAPI 3.1.0; info version 1.0
scope: Exact existing-surface evidence fallback: the preserved source inventory contains 91 official-survey operation entries, exactly matching the immutable count. Shared executable bindings for the same provider method/path are merged into one normalized endpoint. The cited official openapi artifact is retained as the v2 provenance root; no operation was inferred from a documentation crawl. Prior source-surface scope: Pass B full-surface expansion: every documented BlueTally resource (assets, employees, licenses, maintenances, accessories, components, consumables, categories, departments, depreciations, locations, manufacturers, products, statuses, suppliers, audits, activity, tenants) is now a read stream. Every BlueTally create/update/delete/check-in/check-out mutation sends its payload entirely as QUERY-STRING parameters (verified against the connector's published OpenAPI spec at developer.bluetally.com/branches/1.0/apis/bluetally-api.json: every POST/PUT operation's parameters are declared 'in':'query', none declare a requestBody) -- the engine's write dialect (engine/bundle.go WriteAction.BodyType: json|form|none) has no query-string body construction mechanism, so no BlueTally mutation can be expressed as a writes.json action without silently sending a wrong-shaped request. This is ENGINE_GAP (docs/migration/conventions.md §6 taxonomy): a Tier-1 workaround (body_type: json or form) would post an empty/incorrect body while the real params sit unset in the query string, silently diverging from the documented contract. capabilities.write stays false; writes.json is not shipped. GET /{resource}/{id} single-record detail endpoints are excluded as duplicate_of their sibling list stream (a sync connector reads the full list; the per-id lookup is redundant surface for this use case, not a distinct capability).
